title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Announces the Appointment of Julian E. Whitehurst to Chairperson of the Board
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today announced that Julian (Jay) E. Whitehurst has been unanimously appointed to Chairperson of InvenTrust’s Board of the Directors. Mr. Whitehurst has been a director of the Company since 2017, and most recently served as Compensation Chair. Previous Chairperson Paula Saban will remain on the Board, serving on the Compensation and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committees.
